hits.snippet: # Datavault AI to Acquire CyberCatch for $94.5 Million in Cash Datavault AI Inc. (Nasdaq: DVLT) has agreed to acquire CyberCatch Holdings, Inc. (TSXV: CYBE; OTCQB: CYBHF) for approximately $94.5 million in cash, adding an AI-enabled cybersecurity and continuous compliance platform to its data infrastructure and computing technology portfolio. Under the definitive agreement, Datavault AI will acquire all approximately 26.8 million issued and outstanding CyberCatch common shares for $3.53 per share. Outstanding dilutive securities will be exchanged on a cashless-exercise basis. The transaction is structured as a court-approved plan of arrangement under British Columbia law.
